therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Activated T lymphocyte-mediated tumor cell killing
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Immune-mediated elimination of residual glioblastoma cells

results.effect_size: Median PFS: 8.1 months (95% CI: 5.8-8.5) vs 5.4 months (95% CI: 3.3-7.9) in control
results.dose_information: 100mg containing 10^9 to 2x10^10 lymphocytes per 60kg body weight, administered intravenously over one hour
